protocol.initial: Market probability via sklearn public init estimator; no in-place tree value updates
protocol.inputs: Market probability, 10 timestamped spot features, four flow/basis features
protocol.selection: Inner chronological log loss, requiring Brier no worse than raw market; market is explicit stage-zero fallback
protocol.limits: All outer dates previously inspected; limited new-family search only, not global multiplicity correction; no holdout or deployment
